title: Fold the rails, mark in four colours, turn pages from the keyboard, and finish the surfaces 039 left inherited

goals.description: the tour can be walked again, and reopens at step 1
either rail folds from a chevron beside its own title and slides to a thin handle
a highlight made while the notes rail is folded nudges the reader back to Notes
four highlight colours, stored as keys, resolved from the tokens at render
← / → turn the page and yield to fields, tablists and dialogs
the surfaces that only inherited the theme are polished to 039
pages lay out as a stack on a sized box; the pdf.js text layer gets its stylesheet
